claims.evidence: details: Experiment 4 "UL56 vs WT HSV-1 SILAC PMP", files SILAC_PMP_UL56_WT_Unfrac + _F1.._F6. MaxQuant evidence: deposited raws were renamed; the search holds 8 PMP raws in two MaxQuant experiments: experiment 4 = "Exp1_2018_singleshot_SILAC_LMH_Mock_WT_dUL56" (fraction 44) and experiment 5 = "Exp2_2018_Fraction1..6_SILAC_LMH_Mock_WT_dUL56" (fractions 1-6) + "Exp2_2018_singleshot_..." (fraction 55, not deposited). Raw headers: F1..F6 = MPW_CD_HSV_pmp_{10,25,40,60,90,150}_080218_run1.raw (Orbitrap Lumos, 120-min MS2 HCD-IT method, MS1 60K); Unfrac = MPW_CD_HSV_PMP_130817_run1.raw (13 Aug 2017, 180-min method, MS1 120K). Evidence RT/resolution: Exp1 singleshot RT to 192 min, median resolution 77.9K (=120K MS1 method) while Exp2 fractions and Exp2 singleshot have ~39K (=60K MS1) -> the deposited Unfrac is Exp1 singleshot (MaxQuant experiment 4), a separate SILAC mixture from the fractionated Exp2 mixture. exp1/exp2 label these two mixtures; one source per (mixture, SILAC channel).

claims.value: 1 (exp1, Unfrac rows 1-3), 2 (exp2, F1-F6 rows 4-21), per infection-status group
claims.evidence: Two separate SILAC mixtures: MaxQuant experiments 4 ("Exp1_2018") and 5 ("Exp2_2018") and raw acquisition 13 Aug 2017 vs 8 Feb 2018. "At 6 hpi cells were washed twice in ice-cold PBS" (mock harvested at the same time, Fig. 6A "Samples were harvested 6 hpi").

limitations: Partial scope: only the two SILAC experiments are annotated. The 34 TMT raw files (Experiment 1 WCL_HSV_timecourse_* 15 raws, Experiment 3 WCL_UL56_WT_* 12 raws, Experiment 5 PMP_GOPC_KO_* 7 raws; MassPike/Sequest TMT searches) are out of scope for this SILAC campaign; they are listed in BLOCKED.md (excluded runs) and would need a TMT annotation (channel maps are in Detailsofsamplesandrawfiles.docx).

Precursor/fragment mass tolerances not available: no mqpar.xml, parameters.txt or summary.txt was deposited for the combined SILAC MaxQuant search; parse_sdrf convert-openms therefore cannot derive tolerances.

MaxQuant version: paper states 1.5.7.4 for the IP search and 1.5.8.3 for the PMP search, but the deposited xlsx files are one combined search of both experiments (experiments 1-5); which version produced them is not recorded.

The deposited raw files were renamed after the search; the raw -> MaxQuant-raw mapping is established from the original file names embedded in the raw headers and from MS1 resolution / gradient length in the evidence table (see source name claims).
Review status REVIEW_PENDING_EXTERNAL: external sdrf-adversarial-review hand-off; not self-approved.
The MaxQuant search includes one PMP raw that is not deposited ("Exp2_2018_singleshot_SILAC_LMH_Mock_WT_dUL56", MaxQuant experiment 5, fraction 55); it cannot be annotated.
Detailsofsamplesandrawfiles.docx says Experiment 4 had "6 HpRp fractions"; the paper (tip-based SCX, six KCl steps) and the raw original names (pmp_10 ... pmp_150 = mM KCl) say SCX. SCX is used.

Biological replicate numbers 1/2 rest on the two mixtures being independent infections (separate MaxQuant experiments "Exp1_2018"/"Exp2_2018", acquisition 13 Aug 2017 vs 8 Feb 2018); the paper does not state the PMP replicate count.
SILAC_PMP_UL56_WT_Unfrac.raw was acquired with an SPS-MS3 TMT instrument method; for SILAC only MS1/MS2 matter, so dissociation is recorded as the MS2 CID.
pUL56 itself was not quantified in the PMP data, so heavy (dUL56) vs medium (WT) rests on the details sheet plus the TLR2/IL18R1/DUOX1 rescue pattern described in the paper.
